summary: Horizon Bancorp, Inc. filed a routine Form 8-K under Item 8.01 Other Events disclosing that on September 15, 2026 its Board of Directors approved a quarterly cash dividend of $0.16 per share, payable October 16, 2026 to stockholders of record as of October 2, 2026. The filing is signed by CFO John R. Stewart. No merger, tender offer, strategic review, activist campaign, spin-off, or other special situation is disclosed. The event is an ordinary capital-return declaration and requires no deal-terms analysis; no premium, stake, advisor, regulatory clock, or risk-arb angle applies.
